title: 义务教育教科书·英语（冀教版）三年级下册

sentences.cn: 我喜欢鸡肉、牛肉和面包。
sentences.en: I like chicken, beef and bread.
The bread is soft and sweet.
Beijing roast duck is my choice.
I tidy up and clean my room.
I brush my teeth and wash my face.
In the morning, I get up early.
I see a bird in the tree.

sentences.cn: 我看见一只小鸡和一只母鸡。
sentences.en: I see a chick and a hen.

sentences.cn: 长颈鹿生活在森林或草原上。
sentences.en: Giraffes live in the forest or grassland.

sentences.cn: 熊猫是一种可爱的动物。
sentences.en: A panda is a cute animal.
On Tuesday, we sing and dance.
I eat three meals a day.
